This is WAAAAH!!! The orginal bad asses break out in this 3rd person action game,
where You'll be outnumbered and out gunned. Luckily you'll have a lot of really neat weapons to dispose your foes with. While the game is fun with a couple of really cool set pieces, it feels just a tad rushed and could have used a bit more time in the baking oven.

PROS
-Decent graphics, good enough to run on the average PC
-A veriety of really cool weapons
-Story is pretty good
-JETPACKS!! need I say more? jetpacks make this game so much fun it makes you wonder why they didn't just keep it for the entire game.

CONS
-Background and level design is just bland
-Music and voice overs are hit and misses.
-A few bugs

Rating: 7/10

A great game that adds to the Warhammer 40,000 universe, and does so incredibly well, despite being a completely different genre from what we've come to know Warhammer for.

Space Marine is not a cover-based shooter, because you're a friggin' Ultramarine. Ultramarines don't need cover, especially not from any bloody ORKS. But you'll quickly discover that Orks aren't the only opposition you'll face in your mission. Things go south... really, really south. But in a good, fun sort of way... until the final battle... When this game does what I consider to be one of the worst offenses in gaming: A quick-time event for a final boss sequence. Not a battle. A QTE sequence. That's not exciting, nor is it engaging. It's just stupid and stressful for no reason aside from just trying to clear those stupid button prompts from the screen so I can get to the good parts of the game. Only, in this case, it's the final cinematic. Nothing quite like some stressful button prompts to get your prepared for some relaxing endgame, right?

+ Space Marines
+ Orks
+ Variety of enemies
+ Jetpack sequences
+ Powerful weapons
+ Executions to refill health
+ Warhammer-grade violence
+ Fun competitive multiplayer
+ A great story worth experiencing

- Not sure anyone plays multiplayer anymore
- Not enough execution animations
- Gets kinda repetitive at points
- QTE boss sequence
- Stuck being an Ultramarine
- Small scale multiplayer
- Feels too much like a port from console
- Blood decals don't stay long enough for you to admire your work
- Characters aren't particularly interesting
